notes.general_comments:
There were 1129 candidates with a mean of 13.8 compared to 15.9 last year, and the marks ranged from 29
marks to 2 marks. Five questions Question 19, 24, 26, 27 and 28, were felt to be hard as less than 25% of
candidates answered these questions correctly. All five were macroeconomic questions which may or may
not be significant. The majority of questions discriminated between candidates.
